status: editorial outline only; no additional playable quest data
localization: Titles and narrative beats EN/ES. Other fields are internal Spanish editorial instructions; future player-facing quests must be fully EN/ES.

targets.measurement_status: unverified targets requiring new-world playtests; never gate by elapsed hours

production_gate: Validate the natural first-hour playable slice before mass quest authoring, as required by docs/delivery/spec.md. Bounded fixes and a single useful optional chapter may be integrated independently; UI QA alone does not validate survival acquisition or pacing. Outline is not campaign implementation.
count_policy: 5250 is a provisional editorial allocation, not completed quests or permission for filler. Do not split item colors/recipes, translations, tasks or rewards into extra counts. Reserved chapters require genuinely new selected systems; merge weak exercises and reallocate only after review.
progression_policy: Preserve all first25 IDs and five act-I main milestones. Existing 36 chapter IDs and narrative prerequisite DAG are retained; added 54 chapters are optional and no original main chapter depends on them. Main remains 150; gifts have no provenance/use gate.
project_policy: Associated project is not a new delivery every chapter. Reused projects supply context to distinct demonstrations and story beats. Integration prototypes are presented non-consumingly; no duplicate reward. Existing first-hour consuming project semantics are preserved.
gift_policy: Gifts remain usable. Receiving/crafting a prototype does not complete a narrative event or expedition. No provenance gate.
ending_policy: Six module chapters converge into four commissioning phases defined in integration-design. No claim that current six-click controller implements those phases.
